name: Jorah Annison
summary: In the Magic Quarter, Jorah Annison helps spellcasters find knowledge scattered across Azeroth. The Forsaken cartographer knows both the land and the ancient texts warlocks seek.

sections.title: A Scholar of Darkened Lands
sections.body: Jorah Annison makes maps in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, but the work does not hold his interest. He would trade every map in the shop for one good book. Jorah knows more about ancient texts than almost anyone, and warlocks share his taste for a scholar's work.

sections.title: The Cabal's Trail
sections.body: Warlocks seeking the elusive Tome of the Cabal are often sent to Jorah Annison. His knowledge reaches beyond the ruins of Lordaeron, and he can point them toward places where ancient texts and remnants of dark sects might be found. He joins the study of old lore to the geography of distant lands.

faq.answer: Jorah Annison is an undead cartographer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where he helps Horde travelers with geography and knowledge of historical places.

faq.q: Where can I find Jorah Annison?
faq.answer: You can find Jorah Annison in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need to speak with him?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan sends warlocks seeking the ancient Tome of the Cabal to Jorah because Jorah knows more about ancient texts than anyone Strahad knows. Jorah points them toward the tome's lost halves, rumored to be with the centaur of Thousand Needles and lost in transit on the coast west of Southshore.

faq.q: What faction does Jorah Annison belong to?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison belongs to the Forsaken and is loyal to the Horde, serving his people from their capital city.

faq.q: Does Jorah Annison sell maps directly to players?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison mainly advises travelers about forgotten landmarks rather than selling goods directly.

faq.q: Is Jorah Annison ever found outside the Undercity?
faq.answer: Jorah Annison remains in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, though his mapmaking and guidance concern distant places such as the Barrens.

angles.text: As a Horde warlock, you can turn to Jorah for directions to the lost pages of the Tome of the Cabal.
As an undead, you share Jorah's home in the Undercity, where his cartography helps serve the survival of the Forsaken.
As a member of the Horde, you can draw on Jorah's mapmaking knowledge to navigate unfamiliar lands and recover valuable relics.
